Check Elif and Hana apart: 9 vs 3 → 6 OK.  
Elif and Ivo: 9 vs 6 → 3 OK.  
Dev and Elif: 1 vs 9 → 8 OK.  
Ben and Cara apart: 5 vs 2 → 3 OK.

Ann and Gus: 4 vs 8 → 4 OK.

Everything checks.
